source.note: ast.md Nodes: the written text of a StateIgnoredText leaves out the comments; here the diagram comment `#c` goes on past the comment line after the U+2028 (common.md Comment lines) and takes the line `[*]`, so the textBeforeBody of X is `""`, a space, a line feed, two spaces, and `accDescr {}`, and mermaid.js has no start state.
